signedOut.title: Sign in to Agent X
signedOut.body: Agent X lets your AI agents pay approved suppliers within limits your team sets. Sign in with your work account and passkey.
signedOut.ended: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on.
choose.title: Choose an organisation
choose.body: You belong to more than one. You can switch at any time from the top of the page.
choose.unreadable: One of your organisations can't be opened right now: its records failed Agent X's integrity check. It opens again once that is resolved.
none.title: You're not in an organisation yet
none.body: Ask an admin of your organisation to invite you. Once you accept, it appears here.
frozen.banner: This organisation is frozen. No agent can spend until an admin unfreezes it.
more.title: More
more.signOutFailed: You're still signed in: Agent X couldn't sign you out just now. Try again, or close every window of this browser.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Agent X couldn't load this page. Try again in a moment.
notFound.title: Page not found
confirm.choose: Choose what happens. Nothing is chosen for you.
confirm.unloaded: Agent X couldn't load what this change does, so it can't be confirmed yet. Try again in a moment.
stepUp.title: You've signed in again. Confirm the change
stepUp.refused: Agent X didn't make this change: {change}. Its confirmation was refused or ran out. Ask for it again if you still want it.
stepUp.wordsChanged: Agent X didn't make this change: {change}. The words you confirmed it with have changed since you read them. Ask for it again to read them as they are now.
stepUp.failed: Agent X couldn't be reached, so the change isn't made yet. Try confirming again.
stepUp.lost: A change you signed in again for can't be found in this window, so it wasn't made. Ask for it again if you still want it.
stepUp.signInFailed: Signing in again didn't go through, so Agent X didn't make the change. Ask for it again if you still want it.
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.noneAll: No AI agent has asked to pay anyone yet.
approvals.unchecked: {count} request(s) can't be shown: their records failed Agent X's integrity check. Agent X has raised the alarm; they show again once it is resolved.
request.recheck: The supplier's details changed after this request was decided and were verified again. Approving checks it again under the new details.
request.fine: Approving and rejecting ask for your passkey. The amount, supplier and invoice can't change after you approve.
request.viewOnly: Only an admin or an approver can approve, reject or cancel a request.
request.notFound: This request can't be found in this organisation. If its email named another organisation, switch to it from the top of the page.
request.rejectText: Rejecting ends this request: nothing is paid, and the money held for it is freed at once. Your reason is kept on record for your team, and is never shown to the agent.
request.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing will be paid for this request.
request.refused.REQUEST_NOT_WAITING: This request is no longer waiting for approval: someone approved, rejected or cancelled it, or it expired. Its page now shows where it stands.
request.refused.REQUEST_EXPIRED: This request waited as long as your organisation allows, so it expired and can't be approved. The agent must ask again.
request.refused.REQUEST_CHANGED: Something this request was decided on has changed since (its mandate, supplier, bank account, agent or key), so it can't be approved as it is. Reject it, and the agent can ask again.
request.refused.ADMIN_APPROVAL_ONLY: This request is over its mandate's own limits, so only an admin can approve it.
request.refused.REQUEST_NOT_CANCELLABLE: This request has ended or is already with the bank, so it can no longer be cancelled.
request.refused.ORG_FROZEN: This organisation is frozen, so nothing can be approved until an admin unfreezes it. Rejecting and cancelling still work.
request.refused.FORBIDDEN: Your role in this organisation can't do this. Ask an admin.
request.refused.other: Agent X didn't make this change (reason {code}). Nothing was changed.
request.failed: Agent X couldn't be reached, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
request.cannotApproveText: Your organisation's rules as they are now stop this payment, so it can't be approved:
request.cannotApproveConfirmText: Confirming rejects this request instead: nothing is paid, and the money held for it is freed. What stopped it is kept on record as the reason.
request.rejectInsteadLabel: Reject {amount} to {supplier}, as your rules now stop it
request.storageBlocked: This browser keeps no site storage (a private window, or a policy), which signing in again for a change needs. Nothing was changed. Try a normal window.
request.refused.RECHECK_REQUIRED: The supplier's details changed after this request was decided and were verified again, so it is approved only checked again. Its page now shows it: press Approve again to see how it is weighed now.
request.refused.RECHECK_NOT_OFFERED: Nothing this request was decided on has changed in a way that needs a re-check. Its page now shows it: press Approve again.
request.refused.NOT_FOUND: This request can't be found in this organisation any more. Nothing was changed.
brakes.unchecked: {count} can't be shown: their records failed Agent X's integrity check. Agent X has raised the alarm; they show again once it is resolved.
brakes.agents.title: Agents
brakes.agents.intro: Suspending an agent stops it at once: it can't ask for or be paid anything until an admin reactivates it. Stopping it needs no passkey; reactivating it does.
brakes.agents.viewOnly: Only an admin or a developer can suspend an agent, and only an admin can reactivate one.
brakes.agents.none: This organisation has no agents yet.
brakes.suppliers.title: Suppliers
brakes.suppliers.intro: Suspending a supplier stops every payment to it at once, until an admin reactivates it. Stopping it needs no passkey; reactivating it does.
brakes.suppliers.viewOnly: Only an admin or an approver can suspend a supplier, and only an admin can reactivate one.
brakes.suppliers.none: This organisation has no suppliers yet.
brakes.sources.title: Bank accounts
brakes.sources.intro: Suspending a bank account stops every payment from it at once, until an admin reactivates it. Stopping it needs no passkey; reactivating it does.
brakes.sources.viewOnly: Only an admin or an approver can suspend a bank account, and only an admin can reactivate one.
brakes.sources.none: This organisation has no bank accounts linked yet.
brakes.refused.PENDING_REQUESTS_CANCELLE: Its requests were already cancelled when it was stopped earlier, so they can't be held or stand again. Choose the option that cancels them instead.
brakes.refused.STATEMENT_CHANGED: The words you confirmed with have changed since you read them. Nothing was changed. Press again to read them as they are now.
brakes.refused.ORG_NOT_FROZEN: This organisation isn't frozen any more. Nothing was changed.
brakes.refused.AGENT_NOT_SUSPENDED: This agent isn't suspended any more. Nothing was changed.
brakes.refused.SUPPLIER_NOT_SUSPENDED: This supplier isn't suspended any more. Nothing was changed.
brakes.refused.SOURCE_NOT_SUSPENDED: This bank account isn't suspended any more. Nothing was changed.
brakes.refused.SOURCE_NOT_USABLE: This bank account has ended, so it can't be used again. Nothing was changed.
brakes.refused.FORBIDDEN: Your role in this organisation can't do this. Ask an admin.
brakes.refused.NOT_FOUND: This can't be found in this organisation any more. Nothing was changed.
freeze.heading: Freeze this organisation
freeze.body: Freezing stops every agent at once: no request is approved or paid until an admin unfreezes it. Freezing needs no passkey; unfreezing does.
freeze.viewOnly: Only an admin or an approver can freeze the organisation.
freeze.title: Freeze {name}?
freeze.done: Frozen. No agent can spend until an admin unfreezes it.
unfreeze.heading: Unfreeze this organisation
unfreeze.body: It is frozen now. Unfreezing asks for your passkey, why you are unfreezing it, and what happens to the requests it held.
unfreeze.viewOnly: Only an admin can unfreeze the organisation.
unfreeze.title: Unfreeze {name}?
unfreeze.label: Unfreeze {name}
unfreeze.done: Unfrozen. Agents can spend again within their limits.
brakes.refused.STEP_UP_ASKED: Agent X asked for a passkey for this brake, which a brake never needs, so nothing was stopped. Freeze the organisation from More, then call support.
brakes.refused.BAD_REQUEST: Agent X couldn't accept what was entered, so nothing was changed. Check it is one line, with no phone or account numbers, and try again.
unfreeze.reasonHint: One line, up to 200 characters. It is kept for good, so leave out phone and account numbers.
request.rejectReasonHint: One line, up to 200 characters. It is kept for good, so leave out phone and account numbers.
request.refused.BAD_REQUEST: Agent X couldn't accept your reason, so nothing was changed. Check it is one line, with no phone or account numbers, and try again.
payments.title: Payments
payments.exceptionsIntro: These payments need following up with your bank: Agent X never heard how they ended, or the bank's latest word disagrees with what it said before.
payments.none: No payment has been made yet.
payments.noneInGroup: No payment is in this group.
payments.noneExceptions: Nothing to follow up: every payment's outcome is known and the bank agrees with it.
payments.unchecked: {count} payment(s) can't be shown: their records couldn't be checked just now. They show again once Agent X can check them.
payments.why.unknown: The bank's answer never came, so Agent X can't tell whether it was paid. Ask your bank.
payments.why.contradicted: The bank's latest word disagrees with how this payment ended. Agent X leaves it as it is: take it up with your bank.
payments.notFound: This payment can't be found in this organisation. If its email named another organisation, switch to it from the top of the page.
payments.integrity: This payment's records failed Agent X's integrity check, so it can't be shown or changed. Agent X has raised the alarm.
payments.earlier: Older events aren't shown here. The downloaded history holds the same events.
payments.markIntro: If your bank confirms in writing that it never accepted this payment, one admin proposes marking it failed with the bank's reference, and a second admin confirms it. Each step asks for your passkey.
payments.markableFrom: From {time} an admin can propose marking it failed, once your bank has confirmed in writing it never accepted it.
payments.evidenceLabel: Your bank's reference for its written confirmation
payments.evidenceHint: 3 to 64 letters, digits and . _ / -, starting with a letter or digit. Agent X can't check it; it is kept on record.
payments.evidenceBroken: This isn't a reference Agent X can keep. Use 3 to 64 letters, digits and . _ / -, starting with a letter or digit.
payments.proposalOpen: An admin has proposed marking this payment failed. A second admin must confirm it, or any admin can withdraw it.
payments.withdrawText: Withdrawing ends this proposal: the payment stays as it is, with its outcome unknown. Every admin is told. An admin can propose again later.
payments.withdrawLabel: Withdraw the proposal to mark {amount} to {supplier} failed
payments.refused.PAYMENT_NOT_UNKNOWN: This payment's outcome is known now, so it can't be marked failed. Its page now shows where it stands.
payments.refused.PAYMENT_TOO_RECENT: This payment was sent to the bank less than a day ago, so it can't be marked failed yet. Wait for the time shown, and for your bank's written word.
payments.refused.FAILURE_PROPOSAL_OPEN: Another admin has already proposed marking this payment failed. Its page now shows the proposal.
payments.refused.NO_FAILURE_PROPOSAL: There's no proposal open for this payment any more: it was confirmed, withdrawn or ended. Its page now shows where it stands.
payments.refused.FAILURE_PROPOSAL_TOO_RE: You're the only admin, so you can confirm your own proposal only a day after making it. Try again then.
payments.refused.FAILURE_PROPOSAL_YOURS: You made this proposal, so a second admin must confirm it.
payments.refused.FAILURE_PROPOSAL_GRANTE: The admin who proposed this made you an admin, so another admin must confirm it.
payments.refused.FAILURE_PROPOSAL_CONFIR: You joined this organisation less than 14 days ago, so another admin must confirm it.
payments.refused.FAILURE_PROPOSAL_ALONE_: An admin or approver was removed or had their role changed in the last 14 days, so one admin alone can't confirm this now. Ask another admin.
payments.refused.BAD_REQUEST: Agent X couldn't accept the bank's reference, so nothing was changed. Check it and try again.
payments.refused.FORBIDDEN: Only an admin can mark a payment failed. Ask an admin.
payments.refused.NOT_FOUND: This payment can't be found in this organisation any more. Nothing was changed.
